changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: UPDATE conversation_participants p SET last_read_at = latest.read_at FROM (SELECT m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, MAX(m.read_at) AS read_at FROM messages m WHERE m.read_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.conversation_id, m.sender_id) latest JOIN conversations c ON c.id = latest.conversation_id AND c.kind = 'DIRECT' WHERE p.conversation_id = latest.conversation_id AND p.user_id <> latest.sender_id AND p.last_read_at IS NULL

rollback.sql: UPDATE conversation_participants p SET last_read_at = NULL FROM (SELECT m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, MAX(m.read_at) AS read_at FROM messages m WHERE m.read_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.conversation_id, m.sender_id) latest JOIN conversations c ON c.id = latest.conversation_id AND c.kind = 'DIRECT' WHERE p.conversation_id = latest.conversation_id AND p.user_id <> latest.sender_id AND p.last_read_at = latest.read_at
